Performers
Musopen String Quartet (as credited on Commons) (string quartet) Documented

Commons credits “Musopen String Quartet” as the artist. The individual players are not named in the sources consulted.

[1]
Work version
Complete third movement; edition not identified Inferred, not documented

The Commons description gives only the title and movement. The cues cite the Belaieff first edition of the parts (1888) for markings.

[1] [2]
Recorded
2012 Inferred, not documented

Commons dates the file 2012, and the Internet Archive’s Musopen collection lists Borodin’s two string quartets among the music released to the public domain by the project that completed in 2012. Whether 2012 is the session, release or upload date is not stated, so only the year is used.

[1] [2]
Place
Unknown Unknown

No venue or city is given.

[1] [2]
Label
Musopen (Kickstarter-funded recording project) Documented

Musopen is a non-profit that raised money to record music and release it to the public domain.

[1] [2]
Catalogue
Unknown Unknown

The Internet Archive collection has no catalogue number.

[2]
Transfer
Uploaded to Wikimedia Commons by user Kcx36 Documented

Commons file history; the upload comment names the Internet Archive’s Musopen collection as the source. No mastering engineer is named.

[1]
Transfer date
2024-11-12 Documented

Commons upload date, not a session date.

[1]
Processing
FLAC file on Commons; MP3 access derivative generated by Commons Documented

No editing or normalisation by Contrapunctus; one complete source stream.

[1]
Composition rights
Public domain under ordinary life-plus-70 terms Inferred, not documented

Borodin died on 27 February 1887. This says nothing about any modern edition.

[3]
Recording rights
Public domain by Musopen’s release (Creative Commons Public Domain Mark); Commons tags the recording {{PD-author}} for Musopen Documented

The Internet Archive collection of the Musopen Kickstarter recordings carries the Public Domain Mark and lists Borodin’s String Quartets Nos. 1 and 2. Commons quotes Musopen’s requirement that uploaders warrant that content is in the public domain.

[1] [2]

Alexander Borodin, String Quartet No. 2 in D major, III. Notturno; Musopen String Quartet, Musopen Kickstarter Project, 2012. Public domain; via Wikimedia Commons. No audio edits. Rights statement
